source_doc.title: Lumentum Form 8-K — NVIDIA $2B Series A convertible preferred investment (Securities Purchase Agreement, 2026-03-02)
source_doc.permission_basis: SEC filing is a U.S. public record with no republication restriction; full raw text and extraction may be committed.

sources.quote: The shares of Series A Preferred Stock were sold at a price of $695.31 per share for an aggregate purchase price of $2,000,000,000 in cash (the "Transaction").
Series A Preferred Stock ... to NVIDIA Corporation ("NVIDIA"), pursuant to a Securities Purchase Agreement between the parties (the "Purchase Agreement"), dated as of March 2, 2026.

These risks include risks pertaining to the relationship between the Company and NVIDIA; the risk of litigation and/or regulatory actions related to the Transaction; changing supply and demand conditions in the industry

claims.statement: NVIDIA purchased $2,000,000,000 (cash) of Lumentum Series A convertible preferred stock at $695.31/share under a Securities Purchase Agreement dated 2026-03-02 (private placement) — the Lumentum half of NVIDIA's $4B photonics supply-chain investment (Coherent half already in graph via nvda_coherent_partnership_pr_2026_03_02).
claims.disproof_condition: A subsequent Lumentum or NVIDIA filing discloses termination, unwinding, or material amendment of the Purchase Agreement / preferred stock position.
